ubhayahetuḥ उभयहेतुः
Causes which aggravate dosha and disease-specific causes
Factors which not only aggravate a particular dosha but also give rise to a particular disease or condition; causes affecting both mind and body.

ITA-9.1.59 ubhayārthakāricikitsā उभयार्थकारिचिकित्सा
Treatment antagonistic to cause and disease
One of the threefold classifications of treatment antagonist to both the cause and disease.
